solutions.title: Naive backtracking
solutions.strategy: Find the next empty cell, try digits, and rescan row/column/box to test validity.

timeComplexity.explanation: In the worst case E blanks branch over digits and each validity check scans fixed-size lines.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Recursion depth is the number of empty cells.

solutions.title: Bitmask backtracking
solutions.strategy: Maintain row, column, and box digit masks so candidate checks and updates are constant time.

timeComplexity.explanation: Backtracking still explores candidates, but validity checks are O(1).

spaceComplexity.explanation: Masks are fixed-size and recursion depth is E.
